scope: Source-backed parameter scenarios and optional timing/transport models; functional and mathematical checks, not observed wildfire heat validation.

regression.environment: Shared-memory access enabled for OpenMP subprocess initialization; sandbox-only subprocess import checks otherwise abort.
regression.stage: Full suite before the final two rate/probability precision guards.

bibliography.verification: BibTeX plain style parsed with exit 0 and no warnings

independent_verification: Exponential arrival integrals against numerical quadrature and high-precision arithmetic
Attenuated affine source footprints against SciPy double integration and Gauss quadrature
Exact transparent recovery and nonnegative bound propagation
Phase-energy budget and interval energy consistency
remaining_supplied_inputs: Phase-consumed dry fuel mass/fraction and aligned initial fuel
Atmospheric absorption coefficient or compatible reference transmission
Emission and receiver elevations and source geometry
Effective heat yield when nominal FBFM40 heat is inappropriate
Additional uncertainty ranges or distributions for physical parameters
scientific_limitations: Pine/dead-litter radiative fraction is an optional scoped reference, not universal
Grey homogeneous Beer-Lambert medium omits scattering and medium emission
FBFM40 residence is point-front duration, not coarse-cell traversal or full fuel burnout
Uniform and constant-hazard initiation are explicit timing scenarios
No calibration against observed incident heat flux
Incident radiation only; convection, absorption and receiver temperature are outside this model

final_targeted_regression.stage: Final code including strict saturation and relative-only interior consistency.
